title: QUIC server-side resumption PSK acceptance verification
verification_method: Focused requirement-home tests with positive, negative, and fuzz-shaped coverage, followed by generated-triage, SpecTrace, build, full-suite, and diff validation.
scope: Verify that an opt-in managed server accepts only live same-listener tickets with valid binders, selects pre_shared_key only on that branch, and derives PSK-DHE handshake protection while keeping early_data and public API promises closed.
preconditions: The managed listener ticket store contains a live server-issued ticket.
The later server connection has internal resumption acceptance enabled.
The client offers the supported single-identity psk_dhe_ke ClientHello shape.
procedure: Run the focused REQ-QUIC-CRT-0151 requirement-home tests.
Confirm a matching live ticket validates its binder and causes ServerHello pre_shared_key selection.
Confirm a ticket snapshot captured from a completed client handshake validates against the server listener store.
Confirm unknown, expired, malformed, duplicate, and binder-invalid offers do not select PSK.
Confirm accepted client and server schedules derive matching PSK-DHE handshake protection material.
Repeat deterministic identity and binder mutations to prove the lookup and binder boundary fails closed.
Regenerate requirement coverage triage and validate the core SpecTrace profile.
expected_result: Server-side PSK acceptance is available only through the internal managed-listener ticket store and remains closed for invalid or unsupported offers. Early-data, anti-replay, persistence, HTTP/3, and public API widening remain out of scope.

supplemental_sections.heading: Acceptance Criteria
supplemental_sections.content:
- A live same-listener ticket validates the ClientHello binder and causes ServerHello pre_shared_key selection.
- Unknown, expired, malformed, duplicate, or binder-invalid offers do not select PSK.
- Accepted server and client branches derive matching PSK-DHE handshake protection.
- early_data and server-side 0-RTT admission remain closed.
- No public resumption API or support promise is added.

status_summary: Passed locally for focused REQ-QUIC-CRT-0151 requirement-home coverage, including a client-captured ticket replay against the listener store. The final gate passed with SpecTrace core validation, Release build, full Release no-build test rerun, and diff check. The live resumption runner attempt no longer fails on server dispatch or PSK rejection, but quic-interop-runner reports the testcase as unsupported because SSLKEYLOGFILE output is required for its resumption check; external interop promotion remains blocked on that proof prerequisite.
